decks.notes: The primary focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient burn spells and aggressive creatures. By utilizing powerful early game plays like Lightning Bolt and Mogg Fanatic, this deck aims to apply constant pressure to the opponent and end the game quickly. Cards like Fireblast and Sulfuric Vortex provide additional reach and damage, ensuring that the opponent is unable to stabilize. The inclusion of Cursed Scroll offers a versatile win condition against control decks, making this deck a formidable force in the aggressive Premodern format.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Phyrexian Dreadnought as part of a powerful combo with Stifle to quickly bring out a massive threat while also disrupting opponents' strategies with counterspells and bounce spells. The deck is heavily reliant on card draw and manipulation to find the necessary pieces for the combo while also being able to protect it with counter magic. Mishra's Factory provides additional utility as a creature or mana source. Overall, the deck is designed to quickly assemble its combo and disrupt opponents to secure a win.

This deck focuses on utilizing the synergy between elves and various green mana-producing creatures and spells to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. By maximizing the efficiency of mana production and utilizing cards like Survival of the Fittest to find key creatures, the deck can quickly build a wide board presence and generate enough mana to play powerful threats like Deranged Hermit and Masticore. The deck aims to go wide and generate a lot of mana, allowing it to take advantage of strong early game pressure and maintain aggression throughout the match.

The focus of this deck is on quickly deploying cheap and efficient creatures and burn spells to deal damage to the opponent as fast as possible. By utilizing cards like Mogg Fanatic, Jackal Pup, and Ball Lightning alongside direct damage spells such as Lightning Bolt and Incinerate, the goal is to keep up the pressure and finish the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Sulfuric Vortex and Cursed Scroll also adds additional reach and damage potential to seal the deal.

The main focus of this BW Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy through targeted discard spells like Duress and Gerrard's Verdict, as well as removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Vindicate. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Exalted Angel and Eternal Dragon, while also generating card advantage with Decree of Justice. Key land cards like Caves of Koilos and Dust Bowl provide additional utility and disruption. Overall, the deck is designed to grind out the opponent and win through careful resource management and strategic play.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly create a powerful board presence using enchantments like Wild Growth, Sterling Grove, and Enchantress's Presence. By ramping up mana with cards like Serra's Sanctum and accelerating card draw with Mirri's Guile and Exploration, the deck aims to set up a combo finish with cards like Opalescence and Replenish. The deck also includes protection and disruption elements such as Elephant Grass and Seal of Cleansing to control the board and counter enemy spells. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a huge enchantment presence and secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Terravore and Exalted Angel, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Meddling Mage and Cataclysm. By utilizing land destruction spells like Armageddon and Wasteland, the deck aims to control the board and limit the opponent's resources. The deck also includes utility creatures like Weathered Wayfarer and powerful card draw engines like Sylvan Library to maintain card advantage. Overall, this deck is designed to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy to secure a quick victory.

The main idea of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand and board with discard spells like Duress and Bottomless Pit, while controlling the game with removal spells like Snuff Out and Diabolic Edict. Utilizing cards like The Rack and Ensnaring Bridge to punish the opponent for holding cards and limit their ability to attack, while using Mishra's Factory as a versatile threat. The deck also includes creatures like Hypnotic Specter and Plague Spitter to apply pressure and generate card advantage. Overall, the strategy is to grind out the opponent and win through attrition and resource denial.

This deck focuses on creating a powerful combo with Phyrexian Dreadnought and Sutured Ghoul. By using cards like Hermit Druid to mill cards into the graveyard, the player can quickly set up their combo and bring back a huge creature with Shallow Grave or Reanimate. Stifle and Cabal Therapy help to disrupt the opponent's game plan while cards like Lotus Petal and Worldly Tutor provide additional consistency to the deck. The goal is to surprise the opponent with a fast and powerful finish using the combo pieces available.

This deck focuses on aggressive early-game plays with efficient creatures like Exalted Angel and Hypnotic Specter. It also disrupts the opponent's game plan with discard spells like Duress and removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Vindicate. The deck aims to control the board while dealing consistent damage to the opponent. Phyrexian Arena provides card advantage to outvalue the opponent. The mana base is balanced to support the aggressive and disruptive strategy.

This Goblins deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive plays and efficient creatures. By utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Warchief to cheat out powerful creatures early on, along with cards like Goblin Piledriver and Siege-Gang Commander to deal massive damage, the deck aims to finish the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. Rishadan Port and Wasteland are included to disrupt the opponent's mana base and slow down their development, while also utilizing Gempalm Incinerator for removal and card draw.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through countering opponent's spells, removal, and board wipes, while also generating value through card draw and token creation with spells like Fact or Fiction and Decree of Justice. The deck aims to maintain board presence with Mishra's Factory and Faerie Conclave, while using Standstill to slow down the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of removal like Swords to Plowshares and Wrath of God provides additional control options. The deck also has access to alternate win conditions like milling the opponent out with Standstill in play.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy while utilizing Oath of Druids to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Terravore. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Winter's Grasp, while also having removal spells like Swords to Plowshares. The mana base is built around land destruction and utility lands like Wasteland and Rishadan Port. The goal is to efficiently control the game and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up your graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Buried Alive and Careful Study, then bring them back into play for cheap with cards like Reanimate and Exhume. The goal is to overwhelm your opponent with big creatures such as Akroma, Angel of Wrath and Verdant Force, or use them for their abilities like Avatar of Woe's targeted removal. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Sickening Dreams and Rushing River to control the board and protect your combo.

This aggressive deck focuses on dealing damage quickly and efficiently by using low-cost creatures and burn spells to overwhelm the opponent. With a mix of direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate, as well as creatures like Ball Lightning and Jackal Pup, it aims to reduce the opponent's life total as fast as possible. The inclusion of cards like Grim Lavamancer and Cursed Scroll provide additional reach and control options, while Sulfuric Vortex helps to ensure a steady stream of damage. With efficient card draw from Sylvan Library, this deck aims to maintain pressure and finish the game swiftly.

This deck focuses on aggressive early game plays with the goal of quickly ramping into powerful land destruction effects such as Armageddon and Cataclysm. By disrupting the opponent's mana base, the deck aims to gain a significant advantage and overwhelm them with efficient creatures like Terravore and Exalted Angel. The inclusion of cards like Sylvan Library and Weathered Wayfarer helps ensure consistency and card advantage, while cards like Meddling Mage provide disruption against key spells. Overall, this deck aims to control the game through aggressive land destruction and efficient creatures.
